findings.why: 48 give free credentials (free plan, dev account, sandbox or open source) and 22 a trial or credits. 58 can be built today with no human gate.

findings.claim: apps take a static key or Basic auth vs OAuth2.
findings.why: 44 offer both, 30 are key-only and 21 OAuth-only. A toolkit factory needs both schemes first-class; key-only apps are the fastest builds.

findings.claim: Developer and Productivity apps are ready; Finance is the hard category.
findings.why: Finance has 1 ready app and 5 needing outreach (customer-only spend platforms, enterprise data, merchant gateways). Marketing and Ecommerce are mostly buildable with caveats.

App review / platform policy, paid plan needed for credentials and customer, enterprise or vetted-partner only each block 11 apps, and cluster by category: review hits big consumer platforms, paid plans hit AI-native and SEO tools, customer-only hits fintech and enterprise data.

findings.claim: already run an official MCP server.
findings.why: 24 were confirmed by a page read this run; the rest are queued pass-1 claims. 3 vendor MCPs (Twilio, BigCommerce, Vonage) only search docs. AI-native apps are MCP-first (9/10): Otter's MCP works on any plan while its REST API is Enterprise-only.

findings.claim: field accuracy, closed-book draft → verified holdout.
findings.why: Half the closed-book misses (6/12) were the MCP field. The agent's confidence was calibrated: 68% of low-confidence rows needed a fix vs 6% of high-confidence ones, so research is routed by confidence.
